review_evidence: README identifies the repository as code for the IISc Proofs and Programs course; the formal course tree spans Units 00-13 plus labs and miscellaneous developments.
Representative sources prove arithmetic/order results such as sumToN_eq, zero_add/add_zero for custom naturals, hcf_dvd, and an irrational-power existence result.

Unit13/QuickSort.lean defines terminating quicksort and proves membership preservation and quickSort_sorted, while Unit10/Listable.lean proves completeness and decidable function equality for listable types.
summary: Retain the Proofs and Programs course source: it contains substantive formal examples, definitions, algorithms, statements, and proofs rather than only course logistics.
